Balance pool: Stone-Zsela, Stevens, O'Connor, Scalia, Souter, Thomas, Ginsburg, Breyer. Fit governs because the nine Justices share the same bounded standing and remand rule. Thomas's Northeastern Florida opinion supplies the exact opportunity-versus-benefit distinction, and his Reform Party opinion supplies the necessary correspondence between this claimant's alleged barrier and the requested cure. That combination gives him a concrete advantage in carrying the two sides of the shared rule across the plate, grant and procedural components. Stone's strongest competing fit is his approved separation of injury, merits and relief; Thomas can carry that objective with the more directly demonstrated treatment of both controlling standing propositions. The other lower-count pool members remain fully eligible; the identified case-specific synthesis supports this assignment within the permitted balance range.
